sloka: ततः अन्तः पुरम् आविद्धम् मूर्चिते पृथिवी पतौ ।उद्धृत्य बाहू चुक्रोश नृपतौ पतिते क्षितौ ॥२-५७-२७॥
transliteration: tataḥ antaḥ puram āviddham mūrcite pṛthivī patau ।uddhṛtya bāhū cukrośa nṛpatau patite kṣitau ॥2-57-27॥

translations.english: The moment the lord of the earth fell down on the ground unconscious, the women in the inner apartment burst into tears, raising their arms.
